subject.title: Feature Request: Cross-platform migration tool (migrate export/import)

question: Should OpenClaw core own automated same-product archive import/restore, or should core stay limited to backup export, platform conversion, verification, and manual restore guidance?
rationale: This choice determines CLI namespace, archive trust boundaries, secret/session portability, destructive write policy, and whether the open implementation candidates should proceed in core or be reshaped around backup/manual restore.

options.title: Scope a minimal native import contract
options.body: Define a preview-first core export/import lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, and focused security tests before accepting implementation work.

options.title: Prefer backup export or convert plus manual restore
options.body: Keep automated restore out of core for now and improve backup output, platform targeting, verification, and docs so users can migrate safely without a destructive importer.

options.title: Route optional extras outside core
options.body: Keep core to missing APIs and let plugins, skills, or ClawHub packages own optional cloud, scheduled, encrypted, or workspace-specific migration flows.

recommendation.title: Scope a minimal native import contract
recommendation.body: Define a preview-first core export/import lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, and focused security tests before accepting implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: They have backup safety history and already raised the restore security-boundary concern in the prior implementation discussion.
